description.value: Islands Cafe is a Hawaii-inspired café chain and craft coffee roaster with roots in surf culture — the business began as a surfboard company before pivoting to cafés and eventually setting up its own in-house roastery. The Grandview Corners location (branded 'Mauka') is one of three South Surrey/White Rock outposts, each carrying Hawaiian location names. Cyclists riding the 24 Avenue corridor through Surrey will find a specialty coffee stop with a distinct personality and house-roasted beans.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 62m; rack at 62m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for islandscafe.ca loaded successfully and confirms a real, operating multi-location café and coffee roaster business with a Hawaii/surf theme and locations at White Rock, Grandview Corners, and Ocean Park — the OSM record's Surrey address (16041 24 Ave, Unit 40) aligns with the 'Grandview Corners | Mauka' location listed on the website. The website head office address (1237 Johnston Rd, White Rock) differs from the OSM address, but this is the corporate HQ, not a contradiction of the specific café location. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Website footer lists corporate head office at 1237 Johnston Rd, White Rock, BC V4B1H7 — this differs from the OSM address of 16041 24 Ave, Unit 40, Surrey. The Surrey address is consistent with the 'Grandview Corners | Mauka' branch referenced on the website, but the specific café address for this location is not explicitly confirmed by the website content.
No phone number present in OSM tags or discoverable from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating specialty café and coffee roaster at an active Surrey location; the business and its Grandview Corners branch are clearly operating based on the live website.
enrichment_extras.notes: The OSM record represents the Grandview Corners ('Mauka') branch of a three-location chain. The other two locations (White Rock 'Makai' at 1237 Johnston Rd, and Ocean Park 'Pali') may warrant separate OSM records and directory listings.

wow_evidence: craft coffee roaster with roots in surf culture... three South Surrey/White Rock outposts
